section_summary.extract_value: This section describes the participants and procedure for a single study (Study X) conducted in Portugal. A total of 738 women from higher education institutions, private companies, and retail services were initially recruited, but after data-cleaning procedures (excluding participants outside the 18-25 age range and those with excessive missing data), the final sample consisted of 387 emerging adult women (M age = 21.64 years, M BMI = 21.58). Participants completed self-report questionnaires during an authorized break at their institutions.
